_comment: Per-machine roots for runtime/build/build.ps1. Copy to build.env.json next to the case's projects file (or pass -EnvFile) and set this machine's paths. Machine-local: never versioned (add it to the ignore list). %VAR% expands from the environment. outRoot receives logs, summaries and every build output: it must be outside every root below, the build's workdir and the kit - the runner refuses otherwise.
